name: Multi-Functional Tabletop Drum Grater Manual Vegetable Cutter Slicer and Grater for Kitchen
description:
Make food prep simple and efficient with the Multi-Functional Tabletop Drum Grater. This manual kitchen tool comes with three interchangeable drum blades for fine shredding, coarse grating, and slicing a wide variety of fruits and vegetables. Built with stainless steel blades and a powerful suction base, it ensures safe, stable, and effortless operation. Compact, durable, and dishwasher-safe, this grater is a must-have for every kitchen.
Key Features:
 Style: Manual vegetable slicer and grater
 Material: ABS plastic + stainless steel blades
 Functions: Fine shred, coarse grate, slice
 Powerful suction base for stability
 Easy to assemble, disassemble, and clean
 Ideal for cucumbers, carrots, potatoes, onions, nuts, and more
How to Use:
 Place grater on a flat surface and secure with suction base
 Insert desired drum blade (fine, coarse, or slicing)
 Add vegetables or fruits into the chute
 Rotate handle to grate, slice, or shred
 Disassemble and wash after use
Safety Information:
 Use only on stable, flat surfaces
 Keep hands away from sharp blades during use
 Not suitable for children without supervision
Package Includes:
 1 × Tabletop Drum Grater Set
